hero.h1: 9 Best Craft Beer Spots in Nairobi (2026) — Reddit-Backed Guide
hero.subtitle: Nairobi's craft beer scene is young, bold, and growing fast. From on-site microbreweries to taprooms stocking Kenya's best independents, here's where to drink beyond Tusker.

methodology: We analyzed Reddit posts and comments across r/Kenya, r/nairobi, and beer-focused subreddits spanning 2020–2026. Venues were cross-referenced with Google Maps ratings, TripAdvisor reviews, and local craft beer blogs like Craft Beer Nomads. We prioritized places that actually brew their own beer or stock a genuine craft selection — not just bars that serve one or two craft options alongside mainstream lagers.
